items.author: markijbema
items.body:
Currently we only support the codestral-2508 model for autocomplete. We have thoroughly tested this model with both the FIM endpoint which we complete and traditional chat-completions endpoint using the HoleFiller prompt.

We'd like to add more models but have to make sure these other models
1) work well
2) aren't expensive (as autocomplete does a lot of requests)

Therefore we probably do not want to allow full model choice like we do with chat, but probably something more similar to how we do it with Fast Apply.

To implement this we need (at least)

a) an interface to select from a limited
items.title: Add more providers/models to autocomplete, and allow choice

Currently, there is no way to configure **rate limiting per provider**. This causes uncontrolled request bursts (e.g. from parallel agents) that can quickly exhaust API rate limits. items.author: amadshobi
items.body:
## Bug Summary

When the Task tool spawns a subagent in the Kilo CLI TUI, the parent session is **completely blocked** until the subagent finishes. If the subagent hangs (e.g., model streaming failure, silent API timeout, context overflow without error), the parent TUI is frozen with no way to cancel, undo, or interact.

## Reproduction

1. Start Kilo CLI TUI with a primary agent
2. Primary agent calls Task tool to spawn a subagent (e.g., `@prompt-optimizer`)
3. Subagent model call hangs silently (no error, no output — just no response for 10+ minutes)
4. Parent TUI is completely frozen — cann
items.title: Task tool subagent spawn blocks parent TUI with no cancel mechanism
